# B"H — Rich Comment Packed DB (geelooy/api/social/helper/comments/richDb/)

Packed-file storage for rich comments.

- `PackedStore.js` — reads/writes rich comments to packed shard files instead of the legacy folder layout.

Backs the rich comment routes; see `../routes/rich.js`.
